_what: What a person's AI may do on their behalf, as a ceiling kept on the AI's own row (src/ais.mjs `ceiling`): { deny: [need...], allow: [need...] | omitted }. A need is the word a job names (src/own-ais.mjs needsOf). A ceiling only limits: an AI with no ceiling is limited by nothing but what its row can do. A job from an automation may carry its own ceiling (input.ceiling) and can only tighten the AI's, never widen it.

words.unknown_ai: No AI of yours has the id {id}. Ask list_your_ais for the ids.
words.bad_list: A ceiling's {field} is a list of words naming the work, like ["files"].
words.widened: {needs} would widen the AI's ceiling, so it is ignored.
